Drawbacks
Goldsniffer
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 61, Dwarves of Golarion pg. 10, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 331
Category Race
Requirement(s) Dwarf
Your keen senses lead you to hidden treasures. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Perception checks related to metals, jewels, and gemstones.
